The `/savePrompt` command is a VS Code Copilot UI command that saves the current chat as a reusable prompt file. This command is handled directly by VS Code, not through my tools.

To save a prompt:
1. Click the "..." menu in the chat panel
2. Select "Save Prompt As..." 
3. Choose a location and filename (`.prompt.md`)

Or you can use the Command Palette (`Cmd+Shift+P`) and search for "Save Prompt".
